name: Battlebound Rumble
description:
About This Game

YOUR BUILD. THEIR PROBLEM.

Ever built a combo so good you couldn't wait for the next fight?

That's what BATTLEBOUND RUMBLE is all about.

Jump into a free-to-play, 8-player PvP autobattler where everyone thinks they've got the winning build. Pick your hero, recruit minions, mix in powerful spells, and put together a warband that can turn the whole lobby upside down.

Seven rivals. One winner. And plenty of ways to make a mess of everyone's plans.

 

18 HEROES. A WHOLE LOT OF WAYS TO WIN.

Every hero brings their own abilities and new possibilities.

Maybe you'll build an army of unstoppable minions. Maybe you'll discover a sneaky interaction nobody saw coming. Or maybe your carefully planned strategy will go completely off the rails — in the best possible way.

That's the fun of it. Every match is another chance to try something new.

 

WELCOME TO THE TAVERN. TRY NOT TO BREAK ANYTHING.

Around 240 minions. Nearly 80 spells. And a ridiculous number of combinations waiting to be discovered.

Recruit new fighters, experiment with hero abilities and Spellcraft, and find synergies that take your warband from "not bad" to "wait, is that even legal?"

Sometimes all it takes is one perfect minion. One well-played spell. One little interaction you almost missed.

And suddenly, you've got a monster of a build.

 

SIT BACK. WATCH THE CHAOS.

You've made your choices. Your warband is ready.

Now let's see what happens.

Battles play out automatically, bringing your carefully crafted combos to life. Watch abilities trigger, minions clash, and your brilliant strategy either crush the competition...

...or fall apart in spectacular fashion.

Hey, we've all been there.

There's always another round to turn things around.

 

OUTPLAY THE LOBBY.

Of course, you're not the only one chasing the perfect build.

Seven other players are cooking up their own tricks, nasty surprises, and questionable strategies.

Adapt your warband, rethink your approach, and find a way to come out on top.

Because in the end, it's not about who clicks faster.

It's about who builds smarter.

So, what's your next build?

See you in the Arena!
short_desc: Build your warband, pull off ridiculous combos, and show your rivals what perfect build can do! A free-to-play PvP autobattler with 18+ heroes, hundreds of minions, powerful spells, and battles where one brilliant idea can turn the whole match around!
